name: Doodh Sanjeevani Yojana
benefit:
> ***For the Students (Education Department)***

    ◦ The scheme aims to provide nutritious food to the students.
    ◦ The students get 200 milliliters of flavoured milk per day.
    ◦ The milk provided is fortified with added 3% fat, 24 grams carbohydrate, 7 grams protein, Vitamin A 500 International Units, and Vitamin D 40 International Units.
    ◦ This provision is served five days in a week
_eligibility_text:
For the Students ◦ The student must be studying in an elementary school. ◦ The student must be studying in a Balvatika or in Standard 1st to 8th. ◦ The student must be a studying in a Government, Grant-in-Aid, or Primary School located in one of the 28 talukas of the developing tribal areas of Gujarat.
For Women & their Child ◦ The applicant must be a child registered at an Anganwadi center between 6 months and 6 years of age. ◦ The applicant must be a pregnant mother/lactating mother registered at an Anganwadi center.
